text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a kind of rule system that helps it understand patterns. Once the model is trained, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data usually leads to better accuracy.
